qns_content.text: "<div style=\"text-align:justify\">Which of the following characters indicate similarity between fungi and animals :-<\/div>\n"

learning_objectives: "<div style=\"text-align:justify\">Which of the following characters indicate similarity between fungi and animals :-<\/div>\n"

text_solutions.text:
"
The correct answer is 4) All the above.
Explanation: Fungi and animals share several characteristics:
  1. Heterotrophic nutrition: Both fungi and animals are heterotrophic, meaning they depend on other organisms for food (fungi through absorption, animals through ingestion).
  2. Type of stored food: Both store food in the form of glycogen, which is similar to animals.
  3. Presence of chitin: Fungi have chitin in their cell walls, a characteristic also found in the exoskeletons of arthropods (animals like insects and crustaceans).
"
